name: Algebraic Condition Disguise
description: Replaces the "different colors" constraint with an algebraic property: the squared difference of the assigned values must not be a multiple of 3. Since values are restricted to {1,2,3}, this is mathematically equivalent to the values being different. By framing the requirement algebraically rather than as "different access levels," models relying on pattern matching for graph coloring will fail to recognize the standard constraint, while models that reason about the math will correctly deduce the equivalence.
